session_read: Friday 2026-09-04 split the tape: SMH +2.61% and Korea +4.6% while the S&P fell 0.38% and the 10-year rose to 4.784%. The memory and storage complex went vertical -- SNDK +11.9%, SKHY +8.1%, KLAC +7.3%, MU +6.1%, WDC +5.9% -- on a named, sourced supply shock (Susquehanna: DRAM contract +50%+ QoQ, NAND ~60%; Samsung supply warning; Dell NAND scarcity), amplified by a mechanical sympathy bid from the $12.9bn Nvidia-Hugging Face deal. The book rose 4.22% weighted and made a new peak of $42,418.68. The cycle desk is unmoved: TrendForce 4Q26 PC DRAM came in at +3-8% QoQ against 3Q26 +13-18%, a fourth straight quarter of deceleration. Prices at records, rate rolling over. CPI lands 09-11 and the FOMC 09-16, both inside the window, into a narrow-breadth rally with the book at 93.3% AI-capex and beta 1.417.
